param.name: detection-mode
param.gui-description: Auto detects transparent vs opaque images. Choose Luminance for photos and JPEGs.

param.name: threshold-adjust
param.gui-description: Fine-tune the outline threshold. Positive values include more of the image, negative values less.

param.name: satin-width
param.gui-description: Width of the satin embroidery column

param.name: smoothness
param.gui-description: Smooth the outline path. Higher values produce a softer, rounder outline.

param.name: simplification
param.gui-description: Reduce path complexity. Higher values produce a simpler outline with fewer points.

page.name: info
page.label: This extension traces the outline of a selected raster image and converts it to a satin embroidery column.
Select a bitmap image (PNG or JPEG) embedded in your SVG document, then run this extension.
Detection modes:
• Auto – automatically selects the best mode based on the image.
• Alpha channel – best for transparent PNGs (logos, clip art).
• Luminance – best for opaque photos and JPEGs.
Tip: For photos with complex backgrounds, removing the background in an image editor first will give the cleanest results.
More information on our website
https://inkstitch.org/docs/satin-tools/

effect.menu-tip: Trace image outline and convert to satin stitch
